notes.title: A CLAW-some Year in Review: 2024 Edition
notes.content:
Hey Guardians,

The Winter sales begin today on Steam, you can buy Crab God at a [b]30% discount[/b] as well as the Supporter pack with a [b]10% sale[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/9c0090649d43c879bcd3415c03e4804e66fe062a.png[/img]
As 2024 draws to a close, we’re reflecting on an unforgettable year - the year Crab God was born. Creating and launching a game is always a wild adventure, and we couldn’t have done it without you. Your passion, feedback, and love for Crablings have fueled us every step of the way. So, let’s take a look back at our own incredible migration.

[h3]Awards and Events:[/h3]

Crab God officially launched on [b]June 20th, 2024[/b], but the journey started long before that. From showcasing the game at industry events to connecting with you - our amazing community - we’ve had a whirlwind year filled with celebration, collaboration, and even a few awards! We’ve had the chance to meet many of you at events and celebrate the best of indie gaming through the Wholesome Direct, IGN live, TactiCon, SimFest, and also participating in great causes like the Games For Waves Steam event.

During some of these events, we were honored by the awards that we received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/516cd252fe1221774abfa56da82529f486de702d.png[/img]
[h3]Scores That Made Waves[/h3]

Curious about your collective impact as Guardians of the ocean? Here are some of the jaw-dropping stats you’ve achieved since launch:
[list]
[*] Over 290 000 Crablings were hatched - that’s a lot of little claws!
[*] 33 000 Crablings were lost in this perilous journey to divinity
[*] Over 5 million threats were vanquished - true protectors of the sea!
[*] Over 12 million creature babies were born - the circle of life is strong in your ecosystems.
[*] Over 140 000 Ritual Stones were completed - tour divine deeds echo through the ocean depths.
[/list]
And of course, you’ve nurtured a lush underwater world of plants and corals. Here’s your TOP 3 most cultivated plants and corals from the 1.9 million grown so far: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/14214e78c6c86438664671e444c77b8ed2303f15.png[/img]
[h3]Making Waves for the Planet[/h3]

When we set out to create Crab God, we wanted it to have [b]a real-world impact[/b]. Thanks to you, our incredible community, that vision has become a reality! Every Community Challenge you completed and every Stone of Preservation you completed contributed to tangible change for our planet's oceans, reefs, and wildlife.

Here’s the incredible impact we’ve made together since launch:

🐠 1,561 coral fragments restored
🌳 651 trees planted
🌊 1,525 lbs of plastic removed from our oceans 
🐢 985 baby sea turtles saved 
💨 7,060 kg of carbon offset 
🛡️ 1,217,000 m² of marine area protected 

These numbers represent the power of collective action. Your gameplay has had a direct, measurable impact on the health of our planet!

[h3]Clawsome reviews:[/h3]

One of the best parts of this year has been hearing from you! From your hilarious sea puns to thoughtful gameplay suggestions, your feedback has shaped Crab God into something we’re incredibly proud of.  We want to thank each and every one of you who took the time to leave us a review! Here are just a few of our favorite player reviews that really made us smile:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/098503a71851132f52604998e943cc18e88fa347.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/0f0785ab0af03b0b8f90fdc1798223babcd56b98.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/aa6cb216f301abcc2b5cda451ca283c2929ad549.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/405e3d4abd75606781dc7c2534ff60d04a0595ce.png[/img]

Thank you for being part of this incredible adventure. Whether you hatched your first Crabling in June or joined us just last week, we’re so happy to have you as part of the community. Enjoy your winter holidays and the new community challenges, and we’ll sea you next year Guardians!

- The Crab God Team -

Here are the first upcoming Community Challenges:
[list]
[*] 27/08/2024 - 02/09/2024 - Grow 3,500 Star Coral
[*] 03/09/2024 - 09/09/2024 - Complete 3,600 Ritual Stones
[*] 10/09/2024 - 16/09/2024 - Cultivate 4,500 plants or corals
[/list]
Full Patch Notes can be found at the end of this Steam News! Prepare your devoted Crablings, as the ocean is full of dangers and mysteries waiting to be unveiled.

Have fun with the new challenges, and don’t forget to share your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J]Discord [/url]or in the Steam Discussions. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: How is Crab God a strategy game?
notes.content:
Hey Guardians!

Tacticon 2024 kicks off today, and we're thrilled to announce that Crab God is a proud to be a featured game. To celebrate, we're offering [b]a free demo[/b]! Join us in a festival of games that test your intellect, push your limits, and reward your foresight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/2d3306745c4b8eb26bad00fbce5f8309e396b144.png[/img]
Birthing a new Crab God is a daunting task that requires planning, plotting, and patience. Let's dive into what makes Crab God a unique strategy game, from its inspirations to its mechanics.

[h3]Inspirations and goal[/h3]

Crab God is a unique blend of strategy, simulation, and roguelike gameplay that creates an approachable game with deep strategic options. We were inspired by the approachability of games like Kingdom when designing the core loop, and referenced both Viva Pinata and Reus when designing the strategy systems. (If you haven't checked out Reus 2 yet, we highly recommend it!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/91efa6c80742142816c065099cb771a7713ff215.png[/img]
Your main goal in Crab God is to birth a new deity by protecting and nurturing the sacred egg. However, to achieve this you will need to accomplish [b]numerous sub-goals [/b]to keep progress on your migration: defending against threats, building defenses, developing your ecosystem, and collecting food. 

The recently introduced [b]Tide Trials [/b]add even more layers of challenge and objectives, such as completing a run with only 4 Crablings, with further updates on the horizon. 

[h3]What makes Crab God a strategic game?[/h3]

During your migrations through the various biomes, you will encounter [b]Ritual Stones[/b]. These stones bestow powerful [b]Blessings[/b] to your most dedicated followers, granting new abilities to combat the ocean's darkness. These Blessings allow you to customize your play style and respond to new challenges that your colony faces. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/ce4695e6ded93f9e1ad0997c2e1758ae41ceeb86.png[/img]
To unlock Blessings, you need to complete optional ecosystem challenges within each level. Completing challenges requires careful planning! Which plants to cultivate? On which spots? Which ones need to be upgraded first? Which species needs to spawn to satisfy the stone demands? The answers to these questions are never straightforward, making every playthrough a fresh puzzle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/2e56a729e24f89a39c0abb7ad9d299900cb3a92b.png[/img]
[h3]Threats loom in the dark[/h3]

Your Crablings are not just followers; they are your children and soldiers. The choices you make will shape their lives and the environment around them. You can assign your crablings to[b] one of five roles[/b], each crucial for either growing your ecosystem or defending it against invasive species.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/de9f03e02467d2e23c524cc119beadbd70500fff.png[/img]
Finding the[b] right balance[/b] within your colony, picking the right Blessings, and adapting your strategy is critical as you face escalating threats. Each night brings waves of enemies, and surviving these onslaughts requires both tactics and resource management.

If you survive the nights and the waves of enemies, a more frightful and insidious threat will still have to be dealt with: [b]hunger[/b]. Food is an important resource, and a lack of food might endanger your crablings and your whole strategy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/f7caa4c57ceee0fd75a110e538b714e428906e20.png[/img]
To assist you, we've created a Steam news guide on food collection. However, the best strategy often comes from trusting your instincts and adapting your tactics to ensure an abundant harvest.

If you've already played the game, we'd love to hear your thoughts! Share your reviews and feedback in the Steam Discussions or on our Discord!

notes.title: How to gather food in Crab God?
notes.content:
Hello Guardians!

Food is a vital resource in Crab God, but did you know there are many ways to generate it? Take notes, dear Scavengers!

[h3]1. Grow plants to attract new species[/h3]

Aquatic creatures are attracted to the various types of plants and corals that you grow in each level. In Crab God, having an ecosystem full of life is not solely an aesthetic feature; it allows you to produce food for your colony!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/eb436f1f82415177eea7c3f83c25e765684fff48.gif[/img]

Indeed, [b]the fish and other animals in your ecosystem[/b] will consume the flora you cultivate or other creatures in the environment, producing scraps of food you can collect and take back to the temple. Fish are messy eaters, and that is a bonus for your Scavengers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/72237a0472769214a4a756535d5711fd8bc32915.gif[/img]

Moreover, the biodiversity of your ecosystem will also help you in your journey against other[b] invasive species[/b] that are menacing your realm. They will help your Hunters and Builders by attacking these threats, turning them into more food to be collected!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/77448ba4fc74af39b6698374e0b9883f356f3b00.gif[/img]

If you are ever curious about how to attract more creatures, you can always open [b]the Eco HUD[/b] to see their requirements and how much food they produce!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/59e9f0000679bd944438b253966040970e45032b.png[/img]

[h3]2. Treasures await to be found[/h3]

During your underwater migrations, your Scavengers will encounter piles they can dig to find all kinds of [b]treasures buried deep in the sand[/b]! Food is one of the most precious things you can uncover while exploring the ocean depths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/d34a8b2d1de05faf18172562b9f23d09af6e0958.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Hunter Crablings[/h3]

Hunters do more than just fight off enemies that threaten your aquatic paradise! Hunters have also mastered the art of [b]finding food[/b]. Crabling Hunters will automatically generate food occasionally, letting your Crabling Scavengers bring this food back to the temple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/e427681c79d1ab649a52dbd2d65081074fbadda0.gif[/img]

[h3]4. Living on a prayer[/h3]

Ritual stones offer many different powers when they are completed. Among these various blessings, some will give you a large gift of food and favour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/eb248f66548ada87b531c406ea9a4867288f6190.gif[/img]

Your Crablings can also be blessed with[b] unique traits[/b] allowing them to produce food when they complete specific actions.

Now that you have the recipe for producing a bountiful surplus of food, it’s time to explore the ocean's depth with your fellow Crablings! Do not forget to leave us a review and give us feedback in the Steam Discussions or on [url=https://discord.gg/vsxD6n8P8J]our Discord[/url]!

notes.title: 6 Tips to Start Crab God
notes.content:
Greetings, future ruler of the crablings. 

I, the Crab God, bestow upon you sacred knowledge to aid you in your journey. The path to becoming a revered deity among crustaceans is littered with opportunity but fraught with peril. Heed my wisdom, and you shall thrive in this watery realm.

[h3]1. Choose the Roles of Your Crablings with Wisdom[/h3]

In the realm of the Crablings, roles define destiny. Assign each Crabling a role with care, for changing their roles can be a costly endeavor, draining your precious favour points. Favour points are the lifeblood of your divine power, so make sure you collect enough for crucial moments. Be strategic by assigning roles that align with your grand plan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/ce5d00cfcde949643cc8789759129767052a939e.png[/img]

[h3]2. How to gather food[/h3]

Grow plants and corals to attract sea creatures.
Understand their wants and needs to create a thriving ecosystem.
Assign Scavengers to collect food, that the sea creatures leave behind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/751efead9b5ef2b952e8d0e4ff1ec442f334003f.png[/img]

[h3]3. Seek Out Ritual Stones with Zeal[/h3]

Ritual stones are the keystones of your power, offering passive boosts and unlocking new abilities or building options. Prioritize the discovery and harnessing of these stones. Their benefits are manifold: they can fortify your defenses with traps and walls to protect your Sacred Egg, or bestow new powers upon your crablings. The earlier you secure these stones, the stronger your position will be against the relentless tides of adversity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/dfd7b0d9d734dc106b8c790841b5d47dd04e0b6d.png[/img]

[h3]4. Nurture and Upgrade Your Chosen Crablings[/h3]

At the dawn of your reign, focus your divine energies on feeding and upgrading your Crablings, and select two who shall be your disciples. Select those with complementary skills and nurture them until they unlock a potent combination of abilities. These two chosen ones shall be your champions, for they can be resurrected and brought forth into your future endeavors. Their seasoned skills will give you a formidable advantage, ensuring their legacy persists beyond a single life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/c76a04a91cac30cd5f269e3a94707a024b51f43d.png[/img]

[h3]5. Watch Your Hunter Before Nightfall[/h3]

The night brings with it the perils of darkness and the threat of nocturnal attacks. Your hunter, the eyes and claws of your realm, holds the key to your survival. As dusk approaches, observe where your hunter ventures, for it will reveal the direction of the impending night assault. Prepare your defenses accordingly, and ensure your crablings are ready to withstand the onslaught. Vigilance is your shield against the darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/4946833c6139ea5c2cc470a427e4768cd33aebde.png[/img]

[h3]6. Balance Growth and Defense[/h3]

In your quest for dominance, balance is essential. While nurturing your crablings and seeking ritual stones, do not neglect your defenses. The safety of your egg is paramount; build fortifications and lay traps to deter invaders. A well-defended nest ensures that your efforts in nurturing your crablings are not in vain. Remember, a strong defense is the foundation upon which your empire will rise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/b97b56f49badaa6fe20370ee5dcfa5ea60807fd5.png[/img]
[h3]Do you prefer a video format? Watch our 6 tips to start on Youtube![/h3]

[previewyoutube=ACIRjXL8xhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Heed these words, aspiring deity, and let them guide you as you carve your path to glory. The world of the crablings is harsh, but with wisdom, strategy, and a touch of divine power, you shall reign supreme. May your claws be sharp and your shell unbreakable.

- The Crab God -

notes.title: Our environmental actions explained!
notes.content:
Hello Guardians! 

We are overjoyed to be featured in the ‘Upcoming’ section of the [b]Games for Waves Sale[/b] on Steam, organized by The Whale and Dolphin Conservation. During this event, gaming community members unite to gather money for the Whale and Dolphin Conservation charity that helps make the ocean safer for whales and dolphins!

For this special occasion, we wanted to discuss[b] the Eco Rewards system[/b] in our game and how you can help our planet while playing Crab God!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/fe2971f2d69c366342a713bbb60c89c04d2118d6.png[/img]
[h3]How do real-life environmental actions work in Crab God?[/h3]

We wanted our games to impact our players and the planet positively. Games are fun and interactive, and we want to make the positive impact of our games interactive. The possibilities of what we can do with game design and development are vast, and there is so much room to try new things and integrate positive outcomes into gameplay.

During your gameplay, [b]Ritual Stones of Preservation[/b] that are found in some levels will allow you to create REAL-WORLD CHANGE.

You choose which cause you would like to support, and we, the developers, contribute to a conservation-focused organization. These are called[b] Eco Rewards[/b].

There are 5 possible Eco Rewards to choose from:
[list]
[*] Saving Baby Sea Turtles
[*] Removing Ocean Plastic
[*] Propagating Corals
[*] Planting Trees
[*] Protecting Marine Areas 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/846e8f20e40a96fe6fea4a2769ecc97c23516b2f.png[/img]
You can pick between 1 of 3 each time you complete a Stone of Preservation. [b]10% of revenue[/b] received from purchases on Steam goes towards Eco Rewards and Carbon Offsetting. Once we receive the revenue from your purchase (this can take up to 45 days), we allocate funds towards the conservation activity that you selected via [url=https://dots.eco/]dots.eco[/url]!

[h3]How will I know that my contribution was validated?[/h3]

At the end of each month, we generate proof-of-impact certificates. If you completed a Stone of Preservation that month, you’ll be notified the next time you open Crab God. These certificates show you how much impact you and the rest of the community contributed to, and where in the world it happened!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/a2bcb652821c62767d0aa59fdd9c4690340d58a6.png[/img]
There is a limit to the number of Eco Rewards you can complete in a month. Once all Eco Rewards have been chosen, you will no longer see Stones of Preservation [b]until the next month[/b].

[h3]Why did we choose dots.eco as our partner?[/h3]

Through a partnership with dots.eco, we are connected with a wide range of charities and conservation-focused companies worldwide. Dots.eco provides certificates for each conservation action, ensuring transparency in fund allocation. 

Dots.eco is designed for games and helps make impact more tangible and integrated into the experience. It has a great reputation and works with NFPs and conservation-focused companies all over the world. Its strong focus on ocean conservation has allowed us to support [b]many unique conservation actions.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/06db57fe7af27590f505ac8136848636ab7424ea.png[/img]
To summarize how the Eco Rewards system works:
[list]
[*] [b]Choose Your Cause:[/b] After completing a Ritual Stone of Preservation, select the conservation cause you want to support.
[*][b] A Contribution Is Made:[/b] Upon receiving the revenue from your purchase (which can take up to 45 days), we contribute to your chosen conservation-focused organization via dots.eco.
[*] [b]See Proof-of-Impact:[/b] At the end of each impact period, we generate proof-of-impact certificates for all conservation activities. Once this is complete, you’ll receive a notification the next time you open Crab God. These certificates detail the conservation action and its global impact.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/8bc94f0c7f4b87076aefa098f636ecdae4993d0a.gif[/img]

[h3]Economic Viability[/h3]

We ensure economic viability by allocating 10% of our received revenue on a monthly basis. This means that each month's funds from new player purchases contribute to the conservation pool, allowing us to sustain our business model while effectively supporting conservation without relying on specific in-game activities or monthly sales targets.

[b]Impact Transparency:[/b] All contributions are managed through dots.eco, which provides certificates for conservation actions, ensuring transparency and giving players confidence that their efforts lead to real-world benefits.

We hope this helps you better understand our real-world impact system, as we try to be as transparent as possible! Save your dates in June, enjoy the events, and be prepared for exclusive news and footage in the upcoming days!

notes.title: Can Crab God also be a cozy game?
notes.content:
Hello Guardians,

Today marks the start of the[b] Cozy and Family-Friendly Game Festival[/b] on Steam. This festival features a wide variety of games that aim to create a cozy atmosphere. As part of the festival, Crab God offers players the opportunity to enjoy the game by employing strategic thinking or by taking a more relaxed approach!

[h2]Crafting the Cozy Atmosphere[/h2]

One of our primary focuses in Crab God was to develop characters that players would love and care for - [b]the Crablings[/b]! These cute, endearing creatures come with [b]customizable names and personality traits[/b], allowing players to form a bond with each one. Watching them grow and thrive in a beautiful underwater world creates a sense of attachment and warmth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/b23511ab9fbff3a410bf19370e04916c9aeb1e43.png[/img]
To create an atmospheric strategy game, we put a lot of work into the game’s visual and sound design, making sure they complement each other, and then backed it all up with a catchy soundtrack. This creates an inviting [b]environment[/b] that players want to return to time and again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/83cdda4c495114cacbda3527f6a2503b05007e47.png[/img]
[h2]Family-Friendly Mechanics and Visuals[/h2]

The game isn’t just about aesthetics; it’s a game with a positive message and engaging mechanics that make it appealing to all ages. The gameplay revolves around [b]taking care of nature[/b] and improving the environment. Players can grow plants and corals to create beautiful aquascapes, fostering a sense of accomplishment and wonder as they see their underwater gardens flourish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/f4980af7a8aca37034b0b989fa1b5bc155371af0.png[/img]
Crab God has a strong focus on creating a [b]positive environmental impact[/b]; players will help clean up and improve our oceans through the in game eco rewards. They will also discover fun facts about various sea creatures, helping build a sense of wonder with our real-world.

[h2]Inspirations from other Cozy Games[/h2]

We drew inspiration from many games, with Viva Piñata being one of our favorite cozy games. This game involves building a garden and attracting cute creatures, and inspired the discovery and requirements systems of Crab God.

The three co-founders of Chaos Theory have fond memories of playing Viva Piñata together in high school, and this isn't the first time we used elements from it in our games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/8854fc4d31d74ae38b84638bc75eb6bb72851ce2.png[/img]
Crab God is a labor of love, designed to offer a meaningful experience and l[b]eave our planet a better place to live[/b]. We hope that players will love their Crablings, find joy in creating beautiful underwater worlds, and feel inspired by the positive messages woven throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/21d1c780ba7bf10b890b0e364765564ca49fed13.png[/img]
Enjoy the Fest and all the cozy games, we will come back soon with more info!

notes.title: New release date for Earth Appreciation Fest!
notes.content:
Happy Earth Appreciation Day, dear Guardians!

On this special occasion we celebrate nature both on the ground and underwater! We are thrilled to be part of [b]the Earth Appreciation Fest [/b]on Steam among many games that put nature at the heart of their story. 

And even bigger news, we have [b]an official release date[/b]: [b]June 20th[/b]! Dive into Crab God's realm with this exclusive gameplay video:

[previewyoutube=muyNGK5NifQ;full][/previewyoutube]
To make you experience your own aquatic journey to the fullest, we could never have found a better muse than nature itself. Our team has always loved coral reef ecosystems. To us, it feels like the perfect setting for a video game filled with weird and wonderful creatures! We had so many options but limited time so we needed to focus. We picked creatures that were beautiful, bizarre, mechanically important, and then just a few of our favourites!

[h2]Inspiration for Creatures[/h2]

Our favorite "bizarre" fishes are the Angler Fish with its glowing light that it uses to attract preys, or the Cleaner wrasse that swims into predator's mouths to clean parasites. The mitten crabs (one of the in-game threats you face) also fall into this list and the name pretty much says it all; they are crabs, with mittens! The butterfly fish and surgeon fish are both [b]striking and beautiful[/b]. Easy picks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/58b2d839fa1960678c5b13162c7b5988bb5ad611.png[/img]
We also have a fondness for the clownfish (probably the most photogenic fish in the world) and the sea turtle, a fascinating animal that is majestic, ancient, and serene. We just had to put [b]both of them[/b] in the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/a65ce39087429f6514834b61f0407533961d5dbc.png[/img]
And there are also the mechanically important creatures - these are the creatures that make up the base of the ecosystem or serve [b]strategic purposes[/b] in the game, essentially for making a fun experience! The giant grouper is a huge (they can grow up to 2.7m or 9 feet) and interesting fish that naturally preys on some of the threats in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/aba08cd9198b7a92963f47cbb3484eda5ec76e67.png[/img]
[h2]Inspirations for Corals and plants[/h2]

Corals are actually animals. What we typically think of as a coral is actually made up of thousands of tiny animals called polyps. A coral polyp is an invertebrate that can be as small as a pinhead or as large as a basketball! When choosing plants and corals, we wanted to ensure there was a [b]diverse[/b] range from many different ocean depths, and wanted to ensure that they were visually appealing.

The stalked jellyfish is one of the deep sea corals that we knew we had to include due to its striking alien appearance. We knew that we had to include anemones due to their[b] symbiotic[/b] relationship with clownfishes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/a6ac5a11f7aee211e189cbc4676aa44308494f6b.png[/img]
Giant kelp is one of the plants you can add to your ecosystem in the game, and it creates stunning forest-like aquascapes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/83cd81126c0d0b86f3bdb4b2a58ad762430ef739.png[/img]
In the end, we have always been inspired by the beauty and diversity of the ocean, and Crab God captures a fraction of our incredible underwater world. Enjoy the event on Steam and we will come back with more news in the upcoming days!

- The Crab God team -

notes.title: Behind-the-scenes of Crab God
notes.content:
Good day to you, fellow Guardians,

We're thrilled to share that Crab God was honoured with a [b]Game Connection award[/b] during the week of GDC - a testament to the hard work and love our team pours into this game. GDC was a fantastic opportunity to connect with partners and other like-minded developers who are just as dedicated to the crustacean cause as we are (hello there, Aggrocrab team!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/30d0f482a89b85a492ed5b1c8a54079bcfd28396.jpg[/img]
In this dev blog, we invite you to discover how the team works on Crab God.

[h2]A day at the Crab God’s shrine[/h2]

Our main tasks currently consist of working on the remaining features and [b]implementing content[/b]. We always need to focus on maintaining collaboration between design, development, and art so that the features we are delivering align with the game's vision. We also need to constantly check if all these implemented features are working for players, so we playtest the game every couple of weeks to collect feedback and plan the next set of updates.
 
The most challenging aspect of development has been balancing complexity and depth. We have been working hard to make the game intuitive and easy to pick up while giving players many strategic options for approaching each level. There has been a lot of iteration on balancing the level of behavioural AI for the crablings so that they are independent, easy to manage, and have their unique personalities while still providing plenty of strategic options that feel empowering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/502264f45edc3f06af8397dfdc46801347bf3f0b.gif[/img]

But development is not only about the challenges! There has also been a lot of fun along the way, primarily related to crabs! Creating crab memes, animating quirky behaviours like a Crabling’s sneeze, and seeing Crablings bug out in ways that look like features… All these moments helped us shape our dear ten-legged companions into loveable members of your colony! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/72b0462b63ecd590580eac6f5de8b4cc11aec8be.jpg[/img]

[h2]New content for our Crablings[/h2]

One of the features we are most excited about is [b]the blessing system[/b]! It has been a lot of fun to develop as we have seen the Crablings come to life with their personalities. Blessings give a mechanical advantage that makes gameplay more interesting (e.g. new abilities and stat increases) but also gives them personality traits that allow players to start telling a story with each of their Crablings. We can’t wait to hear the stories that everyone will create on their great migration through the ocean!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/252ca43a033f1c6bda414c6e5151b0ff678edd9b.gif[/img]

Creating new content for the game takes weeks of work from multiple team members. Adding a new creature requires concept art, modelling, texturing, rigging, animation, implementation, testing, and balancing. Each of these steps could take anywhere between a few hours and a few days. Adding Crabling animations is generally quicker as they are already implemented into the game, but animating 10 legs can be challenging at times!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/3e9ff83a2f8f2d2e891b7b46e773aad8c1a1f1c3.gif[/img]

The next steps for Crab God are to complete the remaining features and then focus entirely on [b]content and balancing[/b]. We have just added gamepad support which we are testing and refining with playtesters. There is always lots of playtesting and refinement to be done during development. If you want to participate in future playtests to help us birth a new Crab God, join our [url=https://discord.gg/2hHBaGPb]Discord server[/url] for more info!

Thank you for reading this dev blog; if you have questions about development or the game itself, feel free to ask in the comments! Stay tuned for our next updates!

-The Crab God Team-

notes.title: Threats in the ocean 🌊
notes.content:
Hello Guardians!

In this devblog we wanted to highlight two topics that are intertwined: the threats in our game and the threats that endanger our oceans in real life!

[h1]Invasive enemies[/h1]

So many of the challenges faced by our oceans are invisible to humans: rising ocean temperatures, ocean acidification, nitrate runoff, and more... In creating Crab God, we wanted to set a clear and tangible enemy to fight against, to ensure we would have fun strategic gameplay. Our game design philosophy is to take inspiration from nature, but be led by what is going to be fun to play.

While playing, you are building your ecosystem and crabling colony, but you will face threats that could jeopardize your hard work. The main threats you need to overcome will be other aquatic species: 

[list]
[*] Darkspine - Based on the Crown of Thorns Starfish
[*] Darkfang - Based on the insatiable Lionfish
[*] Darkmitt - Based on the furious Mitten Crab
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/4f93c9fef38ed5d8f4735390555af5781307f4da.png[/img]

The threats we picked are all based on [b]invasive species[/b]. Invasive species aren't inherently evil, but we view them as the perfect enemy for Crab God as they are a very tangible and immediate threat being faced by our oceans. This phenomenon occurs when an animal is introduced into an ecosystem where it doesn't have any natural predators, allowing it to reproduce unchecked, and leading to damage to the native ecosystem. 

Darkspine are enemies based on the Crown of Thorn Starfish, which are causing major damage to corals on the Great Barrier Reef. Darkfang are based on the Lionfish which is putting pressure on ecosystems in the Atlantic. And finally, the most fearsome enemy, the Darkmitt, which is based on Mitten Crabs that are invasive in oceans across the globe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/ce24db12ee73a0c41ec3fb13f26ba0abc3a74394.gif[/img]

With crabs being the focus of the game we wanted to have another crab species as [b]the biggest threat[/b]. They fight for the same territory, eat the same food, and will kill your Crablings if they can. They want to control the Crab world and eat all the food. They don't care about the destruction of the environment as long as they can feed, which is why you must protect the ecosystem from their treacherous claws!

Also, how could we pass up the opportunity to include a weird creature like the mitten crab?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/6876220ac7e749427d3edaabb695aeab54b958cd.png[/img]
[h1]United we stand[/h1]

Of course, you are not defenseless against those invaders. 

[list]
[*] You can defend against threats by upgrading your Crablings, unlocking new abilities, and building defenses like traps and walls.
[*] You can also attract creatures that naturally defend against these threats. These are based on real world creatures that have been observed preying on invasive species (usually natural predators from the original ecosystem). As an example, the Titan Triggerfish feeds on Crown of Thorns Starfish!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/95647bd867c433bfdd62e784fcbb40845db79cea.png[/img]
[h1]The real threat[/h1]

We talked to you about the main antagonists for our game but we also wanted to use this dev blog to talk further about real-life dangers our oceans are facing.

[url=https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/coral_bleach.html]Coral bleaching [/url]is something that most people have heard about, but it isn't obvious what causes it or what we can do about it. Simply put, coral bleaching occurs when corals are stressed. Indeed, corals are animals, not plants! They have evolved in an environment that was very stable for millions of years. There are lots of things that stress corals, a lot of which are being made worse by human development: ocean acidification, pollution, and of course, rising ocean temperatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/986d70a458d69e029529559ce0d1a1715cd83045.png[/img]

There is a phenomenon called mass bleaching events that occur when there is a prolonged heatwave that raises ocean temperatures, putting stress on a large number of corals. On the Great Barrier Reef we have had [b]6 mass bleaching events since 1998[/b], but 4 of those have happened in the past 7 years!

Through all the doom and gloom, there is some good news - scientists are breeding heat resistant varieties of coral. These corals are then propagated and released back into the wild where they will survive, breed, and spread their genes.

There is always more to be done, but it's great to see solutions like this being implemented all over the world.

[h1]Our team commitment[/h1]

We, at Chaos Theory, had the chance to visit the Great Barrier Reef in 2017. We wanted to see the unique reef environment for ourselves and speak to some of the people working there. Diving on the reef was one of the best experiences of our lives! Being immersed in a world that is teeming with life. We saw turtles, sharks, reef squid, and so much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/e784cbd100d7e54b1fbddbb531b08a8af1b70d95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/ac794cfa3213797a0cefdf24b7c640d04492cd0e.png[/img]
Speaking with the marine biologists working there, we were told how much the reef had died off in the past few years. We saw a few dead corals while we were there, but it's hard to believe how full of life it must have been. The ocean is a weird and wonderful place. Most people never get to see this world, even though it covers the majority of the planet. We think games are a great opportunity to get closer to an unfamiliar ecosystem.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/cf75713de706a85903149d0cd48adbe5a39447a3.png[/img]
Our team has always been focused on making games about meaningful topics. We want to make fun games first and foremost, but if we can make games about anything then why not make games about our amazing planet?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/e98006588f468e47728b122b98bb5a9557b5502d.png[/img]
That's it for today's dev blog, we hope you learned something about our game, and also our oceans! Stay tuned for Crab God's next updates!

- The Crab God team -

notes.title: What is Crab God ?
notes.content:
Hello dear Guardians!

Today we wanted to present Crab God and all there is to know about the game!

[h2]Welcome, Guardian of the Abyss[/h2]

Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game where you nurture a quirky family of Crablings and breathe life into your underwater domain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/4a3b2160c097e8016121c16c3fcbe4d81c3121d4.png[/img]

As the [b]Guardian of the Abyss[/b], you have an important mission: defend the Crab God's egg. But being a Guardian is not solely babysitting duty; indeed, you will have to help with the protection of your ecosystem, cultivate enough food to sustain it and migrate to deeper waters where it will hatch and become the new ocean caretaker. However, you will not be alone in that journey...

[h2]Crablings, at your service![/h2]

Loyal children and subjects of the Crab God, the Crablings will assist your work to protect the ecosystem and help you through migrations into the deeper waters. Your colony of Crablings will build mighty coral reefs, protect your ecosystem against threats, and collect food for the journey ahead. Develop their full potential and see them become their own individuals, with their particular personalities and also the possibility to name them to your liking! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/2d1e69b6ec752f774ce0feb00dadb1234712a025.png[/img]

If at the end of a migration you collect even more food than necessary, you will have the choice to feed one or multiple Crablings more which will help you level them up faster. Each level gained by a Crabling grants new traits and abilities that can help them perform better in certain tasks or even obtain more life points. You will have the choice between [b]5 roles[/b] to give to your Crablings, switching from one to another depending on your strategy and your ecosystem needs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/699ac74abe2dd961b6deb7e863b2a6511f3ec894.png[/img]

The roles available to your Crablings are:

[list]
[*][b]Gardeners[/b]: their mission is to take care of the flora of your ecosystem, either by getting rid of invasive sea weeds or by adding new corals and plants, that will attract new wildlife.
[*][b]Builders[/b]: no rocks nor stones can resist the builder's mighty hammer (no Thor related pun here). Thanks to their work, you will be able to reach wider horizons for your ecosystem and who knows what you can find beyond your previous ecosystem's borders.
[*][b]Scavengers[/b]: attracting new wildlife to your ecosystem also means more food for your Crablings. Here come the Scavengers whose purpose is to collect these provisions to prepare for the migration to come.
[*][b]Worshippers[/b]: a great god must receive prayers and offerings to sustain its powers. The sacred duty of Crabling Worshippers is to send their prayers at the Crab God's shrine to generate favour, an in-game currency that can be used to change your Crablings roles or to add new species into your ecosystem.
[*][b]Hunters[/b]: these Crablings have two main goals:  generating food and protecting all the hard work you put into creating the best ecosystem. Because you see, you are not the only one trying to thrive in the depth of the ocean...
[/list]
[h2]Lurking in the shadows[/h2]

Natural selection is part of the natural order, but it means you will need to fight to survive! Indeed, many threats will put your ecosystem and your Crablings in danger: starfish stealing your provisions, evil crabs killing your fellow Crablings and many more... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/f573fef8a983083a94f09ea91994d6410f47d485.png[/img]

However you may also be your own enemy if you do not manage and protect your ecosystem with care. A lack of food for the migration means one dreadful thing: you'll have to [b]sacrifice [/b] your Crablings to feed the others. However, the Crab God will not tolerate the sacrifice of their offspring eternally, and as a Guardian, you will have to be strategic to keep your godhood intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/b6cab9a50e69d3b7b07de8697f7ecfc84e1390cb.png[/img]

[h2]Your own ecosystem[/h2]

Build your own ecosystem in Crab God: choose between all kinds of corals and seagrasses to plant and upgrade to create a place full of life and wonders. Each plantable attracts different kinds of animals, from clownfish to turtles, and if the creatures find your ecosystem to their taste, they will settle there and provide you with more food to eat! Unlock all the different species and discover facts about these amazing underwater critters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/af9c40ffb869ca91c960b16739c1ad87de1da590.png[/img]

[h2]In-game actions, real-life impact[/h2]

We told you earlier that you are now Guardians of the Abyss. Well it is not solely the case in Crab God's world. Thanks to our partnership with [url=https://dots.eco/impact-marine-protection-area/]dots.eco[/url], different in-game actions will lead to[b] real-life ones to protect our dear planet[/b]. Our vision was to create a new type of game and to take a step further into the future of gaming, a more environmentally responsible one. Crab God helps you to feel good about making a difference, and offers a sense of real accomplishment, converting in-game actions into planting trees, cleaning ocean plastic, planting new corals, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/f8228ee577cea45229a8c0b58c5c401b00c78e00.png[/img]

Now you know all there is to become a true Guardian of the Abyss! Stay tuned for upcoming updates and remember: make waves, praise the claw! 🦀

- The Crab God Team -

notes.title: Crab God, Our Journey so Far 🦀
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing Crab God[/h2]

Last year, we started developing an original game - Crab God. We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, but it was time to post an update and let everyone know the story behind the Crab.

So, let’s start with the what : 

[i]Crab God is an atmospheric underwater strategy game where you nurture a quirky family of Crablings and breathe life into your underwater domain.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/9982d7949ba5d586afe33850db6cc29230f31913.png[/img]

[h2]In the Begining[/h2]

We started developing the game in early 2023 and have taken it to various local and international showcases, such as GDC, Gamescom, and SXSW Sydney, to test the game and get some feedback (and potentially snag a publisher… more on that later!)

But where did the idea for a crab strategy game come from? Our co-founders - Nico, James and Will, have spent countless hours playing all manner of strategy games. Our Executive Creative Director Nico said: [i]“Growing up, I was always drawn to games that fused simulation and strategy elements in interesting ways... Playing games within the loosely defined God Game genre, such as Creatures, Majesty, and Black and White, were some of my formative experiences playing games... When we decided to start work on our next game, the conversation eventually landed on - hey, let's make a modern god game where you can shape an ecosystem”[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/8ccc5be223f34c59833322fc5396dab797b30c25.png[/img]

Chaos Theory strives to create games that cause a lasting impact. Most games we create fit under the “Transformational Games” tag. Our other co-founder and Managing Director, James, said: [i]“When creating the original idea for Crab God, we knew we wanted to tackle an environmental conservation topic. We have always said that if we can make a game about anything, why not make it about something meaningful? Most of our games focus on some impact objective, and we have a particular passion for coral reef conservation..."[/i]

And that’s roughly how Crab God was born! We want to create a cute, spooky, engaging and stimulating game that positively impacts the world around us. 

[h2]The Journey So Far[/h2]

Everyone knows that games take years to develop, requiring thousands of hours from dedicated teams of devs. Some games take months, if not years, to get into players' hands (e.g. Spore with an 8-year development period). Even though we’ve been in development for over a year, we’re technically still only in the ‘Beta’ phase, where the game’s key systems and core loop have been defined, but there’s still a lot of content to create and polish to do before it’s ready for launch. We are currently running playtesting sessions to collect feedback and refine the game as we build the remaining levels. 

If you are curious to know more about the process of game development or some of the tools we use when building transformational games, we have previously created a few blogs:
[url=https://www.chaostheorygames.com/blog/basics-of-game-development-for-businesses]The Basics of Game Development[/url]
[url=https://www.chaostheorygames.com/blog/introduction-to-making-serious-games-using-the-transformational-framework-2022]Intro to Making Games Using the Transformational Framework[/url]
[url=https://www.chaostheorygames.com/serious-games-development-free-ebook]Create Games that Solve Problems: A Free eBook[/url] 

Let’s focus on how much love and thought went into Crab God. A couple of initial stages deserve some focus - Vision and Innovation. 

[h2]Ideating Crab God [/h2]

Now, to the all-important question: what was the vision behind Crab God? We knew we were making an ocean game from the get-go; our co-founders have a fascination with ocean life because of how unique and alien a lot of it is. Fun fact of the day - Mantis Shrimp can strike so fast that it generates a shock wave and even produces temperatures as hot as the sun's surface! And hailing from Australia, which has some of the most ecologically diverse oceans, this theme was a no-brainer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/19195c08a3ab3deae7d7434320f7933eeb544b79.png[/img]

The reason for picking a crab as our god was more nuanced but also so obvious. Nico has this to say about the process: [i]“Our initial inspiration came from our love for god games and strategy games and the desire to create something unique within the genre. We're also nature enthusiasts, particularly fascinated by coral reefs and the incredible life they host. Crabs, the ultimate lifeforms with weird and wonderful traits, became the obvious choice for our central characters. We believed that by combining elements from god games and strategy games with the fascinating world of crabs, we could create an engrossing game that captures the wonders of the natural world.”[/i]. 

Don’t believe us on crabs being the ultimate life form? Have you ever heard of carcinisation? Check out this video: 

[previewyoutube=wvfR3XLXPvw;full][/previewyoutube]

In simple terms, carcinisation is where some creatures decide to evolve into crabs, even when they come from different species. It's like ten legs and two hands are the ultimate combo for surviving in the ocean and climbing to the top of the animal kingdom...

Thus, the internet crowned crabs the ultimate meme lifeform, and an oddly wonderful crab subculture was born. Because, come on, who wouldn’t love these adorable creatures?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/af861df049e6529e05f1f8f315178027858cdd7a.png[/img]

And it's more than just memes; crabs are in the gaming zeitgeist now, with multiple crab games suddenly announced quickly.

At the recent inaugural South by Southwest convention in Sydney, there was a dedicated game event for crab games, and Crab God was nominated for “Best Crab” in the award ceremony! People just can’t get enough of these creatures, and it shows with the continued popularity of becoming a crab.

Having a positive impact on our games is important to our team, and we wanted to do something special with Crab God. We utilised two UN Sustainable Development Goals while setting our impact objectives - Climate Action and Life Below Water. How did these goals influence our game design? Our co-founder James shared some insight on it: [i]“We wanted to put a percentage of the game’s revenue towards conservation efforts, but we wanted to do this in a way that engages players. In Crab God, in-game achievements translate into real-world conservation actions. Players can be directly responsible for cleaning ocean plastic, preserving ocean habitat, and saving baby sea turtles!.”[/i]

[h2]Creative Spotlight[/h2]

We have focused on creating compelling visuals and immersive audio from Day 1. We want people to instantly fall in love with Crab God and connect with the Crablings as they dive into this world. Our art team pulled together an amazing board with inspirations from other ocean-themed games like Abzu and Subnautica. Creative Lead, Jennyfer shared with us: [i]“We also particularly liked the restrained colour palettes and lush plantlife in the art for games like Astroneer and No Man's Sky and drew on those for inspiration since we wanted to steer away from a consistently traditionally blue-washed ocean screen throughout the entire game.”[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/cc32f66411dc1b3dd9cd87f6d86fa971614f36a0.png[/img]

As for the design of our key character, the Crab God, Jennyfer said: [i]“We wanted something undeniably a big a** crab but also grand and godly. Unearthly and eldritch, but more like an approachable, loving matriarch than something tentacly that crawled out of R'lyeh. There was a lot of googling of cool crabs and temples - we included elements of religious architecture in her design and leaned into symmetry to emphasise divinity.”[/i]

Elric, one of the designers working on Crab God, added: [i] “I'm grateful that Chaos Theory has such an incredible team. Through Crab God's many iterations, we've adopted ideas and inspirations from every part of the team. Making games is incredibly collaborative; there's so much value in every single contributor, and as a designer, I try my hardest to actively seek out and test ideas from everyone and be inspired by all their unique perspectives and experiences.”[/i]

[h2]Crab God partners with Firesquid! and is….coming soon![/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that Firesquid has joined the Crab God team and will support the project.

Choosing the right publishing partner requires a solid foundation of shared values. Enter Firesquid, a France-based development studio and publisher looking to publish strategy titles that modernise the genre and are a perfect fit for Crab God! 

As a progressive indie publisher, Firesquid aims to empower diverse teams working on innovative, high-quality games. Our vision at Chaos Theory Games is to inspire a more sustainable future through the magic of play, and we found a kindred spirit in Firesquid. With a shared commitment to sustainability, a partnership with Firesquid ensures we can reach our impact goals and leave a positive mark on the planet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801058/f8996e33736a2a90c5024cd6d9156f982e735837.png[/img]

[h2]Beyond the Horizon: What's Next?[/h2]

Now that we have Firesquid on board, we can focus entirely on developing and testing the game, implementing dancing crabling animations, and researching fun ocean facts. Keep your eyes on our socials for exclusive glimpses, behind-the-scenes revelations, and thrilling updates as we navigate towards the eagerly awaited release. You can already wishlist the game on Steam!

We aim to launch the game in mid-2024 and will have more exciting updates soon!

You can follow the Crablings on socials: 
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/crabgodgame]Twitter[/url] 
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/crabgodgame/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]
And keep up to date with all the latest game developments and updates on the [url=https://firesquid.games/games/crab-god]Website[/url].


We cannot wait for you all to enjoy the bizarre wonder of our game!


- The Crab God Team -
